about_the_game:
Chop down an entire tree to gather two branches? Catch a glimpse of a cyclops — with just one eye? Mix up absolutely everything, yet somehow still get the job done? That is a perfectly ordinary workday for a hero of Ahapika — the most heroic agency in Ancient Greece.

Ahapika recruits only the most valiant and celebrated heroes. Not every assignment, however, matches the heroic status of its executor. Start the agency from the ground up — from the requests of ordinary mortals to the whims of the Olympian gods. But be careful — sometimes an innocent request to deliver a package can lead to dire consequences.

Living Heroes

Every hero experiences each assignment in their own way — with their own dialogues, their own gods, and their own troubles. One quest, a dozen heroes — a dozen different ways to complicate everything. Play the same quest with different heroes and get completely different stories.

A Story With Character

Your adventures will plunge you into a world of intrigue and mystery in Ancient Hellas. The gods are not merely a source of assignments: they intervene in battle, grant blessings and impose curses — sometimes simultaneously, and always for very personal reasons. Only your actions will determine which side you end up on and who will come to your aid in the decisive hour.

Not Just Survival

Forget "survive for N minutes" — every assignment here has its own story. Dozens of unique story-driven quests with different types of tasks: battles with bosses, delivery, resource gathering, and much more. A variety of heroes, diverse weapons, powerful amulets and Divine Gifts. Hone your skills in the endless arena mode once the story is complete.

Ahapika is waiting for new heroes. Experience in olive picking is a plus.

Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Dual Core+
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600/9600GT, ATI/AMD Radeon HD2600/3600 Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
